ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.

20. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Sounds that alert us and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
